DanlTech Repo

This is a repository of apps to be used with F-Droid. Applications in this repository are either official binaries built by the original application developers, or are binaries built from source by the admin of DanlTech using the tools on https://gitlab.com/fdroid.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://danltech.github.io/dt-fd-repo/repo
